lounges.name: Air China Premium Lounge (T2, Level 4)
lounges.location: Domestic departures, Level 4, about 10 metres after First/Business security checkpoint 1. This is the upper member lounge, separate from the Level 2 premium-cabin section.

hours.note: Air China’s simplified-Chinese directory lists 04:55 until the last flight finishes. Its traditional-Chinese page instead starts two hours before the first departure and closes after final boarding; confirm early-morning opening for your flight.

lounges.name: Air China First and Business Class Lounge (T2, Level 2)
lounges.location: Domestic departures, Level 2, reached from Air China’s lounge entrance just after First/Business security checkpoint 1. Follow staff directions to the separate lower premium-cabin section.

hours.note: Air China’s simplified-Chinese directory lists 04:55 until the last flight finishes. Its traditional-Chinese page instead starts two hours before the first departure and closes after final boarding; confirm early-morning opening for your flight.

recommendation.summary: The separate domestic premium-cabin lounge offers showers and Wi-Fi.

lounges.note: Star Alliance Gold alone does not grant this section; use the separate Level 4 member lounge. Air China’s traditional-Chinese directory identifies the premium section explicitly, while its simplified-Chinese page labels both floors as Premium Lounges. Hot food is published; dining style and dedicated rest facilities remain unverified.

qualityRating.summary: July 2025 and January 2026 firsthand reports praise the separate downstairs premium section’s spacious seating, quieter atmosphere and regional food. These visits do not establish peak-time conditions or the quality of the upstairs member lounge.

lounges.name: China Eastern V2 Lounge (T2 Domestic)
lounges.location: Domestic departures, north concourse, Level 2, opposite Gate 214. Separate from the neighbouring Sichuan Airlines lounge.

hours.note: Priority Pass lists 06:00 until the last China Eastern flight. Plaza Premium’s partner listing starts at 05:30; use the Priority Pass opening rule for that membership and confirm the day’s final service.

accessRules.label: Priority Pass on China Eastern, Shanghai or China United domestic flights

recommendation.summary: A domestic Priority Pass option for MU, FM and KN flights, with daybeds and Wi-Fi.

lounges.note: Priority Pass lists complimentary daybeds. Food and beverages are available, but the current dining style, showers and spa are unverified. The two-hour limit is a visit allowance, not a two-hour pre-departure entry window. A Plaza Premium booking link does not establish access through every paid-lounge membership.

qualityRating.summary: A July 2024 visit, reported in December 2024, found comfortable surroundings, ample seating and tasty made-to-order noodles after lunch service. This older account covers the China Eastern section separately from neighbouring Sichuan Airlines; current crowding and food may differ.

lounges.name: International First and Business Class Lounge (T1)
lounges.location: International departures, Level 3 beside Gate 117. After security and border control, descend to Level 3; the lounge is behind the escalator/lift.

hours.note: EVA Air publishes 07:00–22:30 subject to flight schedules; Asiana describes opening during flight operations. Confirm availability for an early or late departure.

accessRules.label: Singapore Airlines Business or First Class invitation
conditions: Use the lounge named on your boarding pass or confirm the invitation with Singapore Airlines check-in.

accessRules.label: Star Alliance Gold on a Singapore Airlines departure
conditions: Confirm Singapore Airlines has assigned this third-party lounge on your boarding pass or at check-in.

recommendation.summary: An international partner lounge with showers and Wi-Fi when your airline issues an invitation.

lounges.note: Warm food and snacks are confirmed; the current dining style and private rest facilities remain unverified. This guide currently encodes Singapore Airlines invitations only. Other airlines may use this lounge, but their individual contracts need checking; neither Priority Pass nor Star Alliance status alone grants blanket access.

qualityRating.summary: A January 2025 visit found a clean, spacious lounge with plenty of seating, a buffet and noodle counter. The reviewer visited at a quiet time and did not taste the food, so the assessment is stronger on comfort than meal quality.
